worldcombat.skill.gastroacid.summary: Hurls stomach acid at the target; the fluid eliminates the target's Ability.
worldcombat.skill.gastroacid.use.0: Strip one key Ability off a target
worldcombat.skill.gastroacid.use.1: Suppress persistent Abilities like Intimidate or Levitate
worldcombat.skill.gastroacid.description: Spits an acid glob up to %1$s blocks away; %2$s s wind-up, about %3$s blocks/tick.
A coated Pokemon's Ability is suppressed for %1$s s, then returns.
worldcombat.skill.gastroacid.thick.0: Thick acid: suppression x1.6 and cooldown +22 ticks, for taking out a key Ability in one spit.
worldcombat.skill.gastroacid.thick.1: Thin acid: suppression x0.55 and cooldown -12 ticks, for frequent harassment.
worldcombat.skill.gastroacid.timing: Range %1$s blocks, %2$s s wind-up, %3$s s recovery, %4$s PP, %5$s s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.gastroacid.growth.0: At level %1$s the cooldown from commit drops to %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.gastroacid.growth.1: At level %1$s the cooldown drops again to %2$s s.
On = thick acid: suppression x1.6 and cooldown +22 ticks, taking out a key Ability in one spit. Off = thin acid: suppression x0.55 and cooldown -12 ticks, for frequent harassment. Duration trades against cast frequency.
The move is considered only when the threat is within this distance; larger means stripping Abilities from farther away, smaller means only at close range.
On: a holding companion will leave its post to strip the target's Ability. Off: it casts only where it already stands.
